examples.english: The salesman made dubious claims about the product's health benefits.
examples.persian: فروشنده ادعاهای مشکوک و نامطمئنی درباره فواید سلامتی این محصول مطرح کرد.

miniContext: The salesman made dubious claims about the product's health benefits.

examples.english: His duplicity was exposed when two different versions of his story emerged.
examples.persian: دو رویی و فریبکاری او زمانی فاش شد که دو نسخه متفاوت از داستانش آشکار شد.

miniContext: His duplicity was exposed when two different versions of his story emerged.

examples.english: Her apartment has an eclectic mix of vintage furniture and modern art.
examples.persian: آپارتمان او ترکیبی منتخب از منابع گوناگون، شامل مبلمان قدیمی و هنر مدرن است.

miniContext: Her apartment has an eclectic mix of vintage furniture and modern art.

examples.english: The new vaccine proved highly efficacious against the virus in clinical trials.
examples.persian: واکسن جدید در آزمایش‌های بالینی در برابر ویروس بسیار موثر و کارآمد نشان داده شد.

miniContext: The new vaccine proved highly efficacious against the virus in clinical trials.

examples.english: Firing an employee for reporting fraud was an egregious abuse of power.
examples.persian: اخراج یک کارمند به خاطر گزارش تقلب، سوءاستفاده‌ای بسیار بد و آشکار از قدرت بود.

miniContext: Firing an employee for reporting fraud was an egregious abuse of power.

examples.english: The comedian's opening joke elicited loud laughter from the crowd.
examples.persian: جوک ابتدایی کمدین خنده بلندی را از جمعیت برانگیخت.

miniContext: The comedian's opening joke elicited loud laughter from the crowd.

examples.english: A cure for the common cold has remained elusive for decades.
examples.persian: درمان سرماخوردگی معمولی برای دهه‌ها گریزان و دشواریاب باقی مانده است.

miniContext: A cure for the common cold has remained elusive for decades.

examples.english: He tends to embellish his travel stories with details that never actually happened.
examples.persian: او عادت دارد داستان‌های سفرش را با جزئیاتی که واقعاً اتفاق نیفتاده‌اند، شاخ‌وبرگ بدهد.

miniContext: He tends to embellish his travel stories with details that never actually happened.

examples.english: An eminent surgeon was flown in to perform the delicate operation.
examples.persian: یک جراح برجسته و سرشناس برای انجام آن عمل حساس با هواپیما آورده شد.

miniContext: An eminent surgeon was flown in to perform the delicate operation.

examples.english: The researchers gathered empirical data before drawing any conclusions.
examples.persian: پژوهشگران پیش از نتیجه‌گیری، داده‌های تجربی جمع‌آوری کردند.

miniContext: The researchers gathered empirical data before drawing any conclusions.

examples.english: Why the ancient city was abandoned remains an enigma to historians.
examples.persian: دلیل ترک‌شدن آن شهر باستانی هنوز برای تاریخ‌نگاران یک معما باقی مانده است.

miniContext: Why the ancient city was abandoned remains an enigma to historians.

examples.english: Years of enmity between the two families finally ended with the wedding.
examples.persian: سال‌ها دشمنی بین آن دو خانواده سرانجام با آن ازدواج پایان یافت.

miniContext: Years of enmity between the two families finally ended with the wedding.

examples.english: Social media fame is often ephemeral, fading within a few weeks.
examples.persian: شهرت در شبکه‌های اجتماعی اغلب زودگذر است و در عرض چند هفته کم‌رنگ می‌شود.

miniContext: Social media fame is often ephemeral, fading within a few weeks.

examples.english: She faced the bad news with remarkable equanimity, never raising her voice.
examples.persian: او با خونسردی و آرامش قابل‌توجهی با آن خبر بد روبرو شد و هرگز صدایش را بلند نکرد.

miniContext: She faced the bad news with remarkable equanimity, never raising her voice.

examples.english: When asked about the missing funds, the treasurer began to equivocate.
examples.persian: وقتی درباره وجوه گم‌شده از خزانه‌دار سؤال شد، او شروع به دوپهلو سخن گفتن کرد.

miniContext: When asked about the missing funds, the treasurer began to equivocate.

examples.english: The erudite professor could quote Latin poetry from memory.
examples.persian: آن استاد دانشمند و فرهیخته می‌توانست شعر لاتین را از حفظ بخواند.

miniContext: The erudite professor could quote Latin poetry from memory.

meaning: فقط برای گروهی خاص قابل فهم

examples.english: The club discusses esoteric topics in medieval philosophy that few outsiders understand.
examples.persian: این باشگاه درباره موضوعات اسرارآمیزی در فلسفه قرون‌وسطی بحث می‌کند که کمتر کسی از بیرون آن را می‌فهمد.

miniContext: The club discusses esoteric topics in medieval philosophy that few outsiders understand.

examples.english: Her calm response evinced a confidence that surprised everyone in the room.
examples.persian: واکنش آرام او اعتمادبه‌نفسی را نشان داد که همه در آن اتاق را شگفت‌زده کرد.

miniContext: Her calm response evinced a confidence that surprised everyone in the room.

examples.english: Scratching the rash will only exacerbate the irritation.
examples.persian: خاراندن آن جوش فقط التهاب را بدتر خواهد کرد.

miniContext: Scratching the rash will only exacerbate the irritation.

examples.english: New DNA evidence finally exonerated the man after fifteen years in prison.
examples.persian: شواهد جدید دی‌ان‌ای سرانجام پس از پانزده سال حبس، آن مرد را تبرئه کرد.

miniContext: New DNA evidence finally exonerated the man after fifteen years in prison.

examples.english: Taking the highway was the most expedient route, even if it wasn't scenic.
examples.persian: استفاده از بزرگراه مصلحتی‌ترین و مناسب‌ترین مسیر بود، حتی اگر منظره خوبی نداشت.

miniContext: Taking the highway was the most expedient route, even if it wasn't scenic.

examples.english: The coach extolled the rookie's work ethic in front of the whole team.
examples.persian: مربی اخلاق کاری بازیکن تازه‌کار را در برابر تمام تیم بسیار ستود.

miniContext: The coach extolled the rookie's work ethic in front of the whole team.

examples.english: His argument rested on a fallacious assumption about human behavior.
examples.persian: استدلال او بر فرضی مغالطه‌آمیز و نادرست درباره رفتار انسانی استوار بود.

miniContext: His argument rested on a fallacious assumption about human behavior.

examples.english: The chef is fastidious about the freshness of every ingredient he uses.
examples.persian: سرآشپز درباره تازگی هر ماده‌ای که استفاده می‌کند، بسیار دقیق و سخت‌گیر است.

miniContext: The chef is fastidious about the freshness of every ingredient he uses.

examples.english: The crowd offered fervent prayers for the missing hikers' safe return.
examples.persian: جمعیت دعاهایی پرحرارت برای بازگشت سالم کوهنوردان گم‌شده کردند.

miniContext: The crowd offered fervent prayers for the missing hikers' safe return.

examples.english: Parking in the fire lane was a flagrant violation of safety rules.
examples.persian: پارک کردن در مسیر آتش‌نشانی، نقضی آشکارا ناپسند از قوانین ایمنی بود.

miniContext: Parking in the fire lane was a flagrant violation of safety rules.

examples.english: Gas prices tend to fluctuate sharply during the summer travel season.
examples.persian: قیمت بنزین در فصل تعطیلات تابستانی معمولاً به‌شدت نوسان می‌کند.

miniContext: Gas prices tend to fluctuate sharply during the summer travel season.

examples.english: She forbore from commenting on her sister's questionable fashion choices.
examples.persian: او از اظهار نظر درباره انتخاب‌های پوشش مشکوک خواهرش خودداری کرد.

miniContext: She forbore from commenting on her sister's questionable fashion choices.

examples.english: Meeting her future business partner on that flight was entirely fortuitous.
examples.persian: آشنایی او با شریک تجاری آینده‌اش در آن پرواز کاملاً تصادفی و خوشایند بود.

miniContext: Meeting her future business partner on that flight was entirely fortuitous.

examples.english: The judge dismissed the lawsuit as frivolous and a waste of court time.
examples.persian: قاضی آن شکایت را بیهوده و سطحی و اتلاف وقت دادگاه دانست و آن را رد کرد.

miniContext: The judge dismissed the lawsuit as frivolous and a waste of court time.
